WITH telescope_phase_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
station_bandwidth_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as station_avg_bandwidth
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage, o.observstation
),
phase_bandwidth_avg AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(station_avg_bandwidth) as avg_bandwidth
  FROM station_bandwidth_avg
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as grand_total FROM telescope_phase_counts
)
SELECT
  tpc.lunarstage,
  pba.avg_bandwidth,
  tpc.telescope_count,
  tpc.telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_count) as share
FROM telescope_phase_counts tpc
LEFT JOIN phase_bandwidth_avg pba ON tpc.lunarstage = pba.lunarstage
ORDER BY tpc.lunarstage
